neighborhoods.name: Amsterdam-Centrum (Canal Belt + Oostelijke Eilanden / Herengracht–Singel–Piet Heinkade)
neighborhoods.rationale: Where AI Tinkerers Amsterdam actually runs: Nov 2025 edition venues-sponsored by Mindspace Herengracht, May 2025 Demo Night at NIO House on the Herengracht/Leidsegracht corner, plus CreativeMornings Amsterdam anchors at TQ (Singel 542) and DevOpsDays Amsterdam 2026 picks community-priced Pakhuis de Zwijger on Piet Heinkade — both explicitly bilingual NL/EN rooms of 50–200 with coffee service.
avoid_too: Skip the RAI/Europaplein halls — 8,000-person TechEx / KubeCon scale, overkill and overpriced
Skip the Zuidas/Gustav Mahlerlaan towers — Snowflake BUILD and Amac Pro 'Hoe Toekomstbestendig' sessions are vendor-lunch corporate, wrong energy for a bilingual hack-day
Skip Jordaan boutique cafés (e.g., IJdok 4-style 'Startup Pitch & Networking' spots) — tiny standing-room, no AV or tables for a 50–200 person build day

neighborhoods.name: Amsterdam-Noord / NDSM-werf (Van der Pek–NDSM-Plein corridor)
neighborhoods.rationale: The industrial shipyard is where Europe's actual dev festivals landed: TNW Conference Jun 19–20 2025 & 2026 at NDSM-Plein 90C, Hello Tomorrow Global Summit 11–12 Jun 2026 at NDSM-werf, React Summit ferry-linked to North Riverside, and the Rust Developers Amsterdam meetup landed at BlockTech NDSM — plus Pllek (TT Neveritaweg 59) openly rents a 200-person event room with coffee-bar kitchen, sized exactly for this brief.
avoid_too: Skip the Kromhouthal / React Summit main hall — it's curated-conference scale and booked through GitNation, not a rentable café
Skip the A'DAM Tower Lookout floors — tickets-and-brand-deal corporate, no daytime take-over for a coffee/hack day
Skip the far-North Overhoeks/Tolhuistuin small rooms — <40 capacity and programmed by resident arts orgs

neighborhoods.name: Amsterdam-Oost / Science Park (Mathematical routes Matrix One, Lab42, Startup Village, MARINETERREIN)
neighborhoods.rationale: Ground zero for recurring AI/dev rituals: AI Tinkerers Amsterdam June 2025 was hosted at UvA Lab42 with Fireworks.ai, the Amsterdam Policy Hackathon ran Sep 12–14 2025 onsite with 80+ builders, Startup Village explicitly lists 'Hackathon' bookable offers as an AI/Quantum hub, and nearby Impact Hub Marineterrein hosts startup hackathons — the whole corridor is UvA bilingual by default.
avoid_too: Skip the IoT/Science Park 'Matrix One' and campus auditoria — university-booking only and term-crowded
Skip ING Cedar / Bijlmerdreef (Amsterdam-Zuidoost) — banks-only hackathons (ING Global Hackathon), closed to external organisers
Skip OBA Centraal (Openbare Bibliotheek) Boekenzaal — great café but strictly daytime library hours and queueing rules block hack-day power strips
